result_class: post-hoc Total-Text TRAIN-holdout BERT methods development; approximate reproduction; not TEST/Table5
parameter_selection: Predeclared small method battery after negative v2 TRAIN results. No TEST loaded; this reused TRAIN-holdout is development data, not independent validation. No additional threshold sweep.

scientific_choices.rationale: User-requested BERT extension inspired by NeuSpell (EMNLP Demos 2020). This English spelling-trained head is frozen; natural/synthetic spelling errors differ from scene OCR.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: May handle error patterns better than generic MLM; proper names and non-English labels may be replaced.

scientific_choices.rationale: Pinned author snippet averages noisy-word BERT subword states before its genuine 100002-class word head. Preserve source idx2token order and special IDs; authenticate Git blobs and HF LFS weight metadata. No downloaded Python is executed.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Faithful decoding of the pretrained spelling head, with local fast-offset target extraction checked separately.

scientific_choices.rationale: Same latest completed letterbox single-head word_f1_control, masks->external contours->PARSeq, TRAIN-holdout125, originalRGB crops, native256, padding0/no area or top10 filters, SHA-bound cached outputs.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Preserves localization ceiling and paired crop identities across all arms.

scientific_choices.rationale: Eligible ASCII single words >=3; protect numbers/punctuation/mixed-case names/multiword crops. Original OCR word remains visible. Raw-head control plus fixed conservative edit/probability/KEEP gates; sum casefold label probabilities for in-vocabulary KEEP, but never replace an OOV string's unscoreable probability by UNK. Optional caption prefix budget80 words; over256 input tokens or unknown target causes explicit KEEP.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Prevents unbounded conservative rewrites; restrictions and word-head vocabulary limit recoverability. Probabilities are not calibrated correctness estimates.

scientific_choices.rationale: Micro exact Unicode casefold retained-punctuation bboxIoU>=0.5 deterministic one-to-one matching, all983 care GT denominator, recovered/damaged/changed and unchanged geometry. Not the official polygon protocol.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Paired TRAIN diagnostic only; no Table5 or TEST transfer claim.

scientific_choices.rationale: Cached upstream outputs and isolated CPU or CUDA:0 FP32 word-head inference; batch8, max256 tokens, four CPU threads, deterministic seeds/settings. No co-resident mask/PARSeq/caption models.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Records correction-only timing/shapes and allocated/reserved GPU peaks; not paper end-to-end execution.

scientific_choices.rationale: Pretrained weights and label vocabulary have been downloaded and authenticated. Correction benefit, conservative thresholds, caption conditioning and GPU memory require paired real inference; optional captions must cover the same SHA-bound Total-Text images.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: No improvement, calibrated threshold, caption benefit or strict reproduction claim is supported before measurement.

scientific_choices.rationale: The pinned tokenizer_config omits do_lower_case; AutoTokenizer in the installed transformers 4.47.1 resolves True, matching the unmodified author HF snippet call. Record True explicitly and retain mismatch failure rather than force a flag. The v1 False expectation was inferred incorrectly from the model name. Training-time intended casing versus the HF export is unresolved.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Encoder inputs are lowercased, while original OCR text and conservative output casing remain preserved. This matches published HF loading behavior; it is not a strict qualification of training-time preprocessing.

scientific_choices.rationale: Authenticated checkpoint contains bert.embeddings.position_ids, absent from modern state_dict because the library regenerates it. Require identical shape, dtype and every value against the current BERT buffer before excluding this explicitly allowed key; load all learned tensors strictly.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Checkpoint format compatibility without changing position indices or learned parameters. Any non-equivalent saved buffer is a fatal error.

scientific_choices.rationale: Compare published default lowercase and an explicit cased tokenizer following the original toolkit named BERT encoder. Export/training casing ambiguity remains unresolved; old v2 outputs are retained.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Test sensitivity to input casing without changing weights or thresholds.

scientific_choices.rationale: Inspired by local edit models/LevOCR, retain only OOV original words and predicted missing-letter insertions at fixed probability/edit limits. The English word-head vocabulary is pretrained external evidence, not Total-Text GT.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: May reduce rare-name substitution damage at the cost of insertion recall; not a trained PIE/LevOCR reproduction.

scientific_choices.rationale: Use bounded NeuSpell top-label candidates plus immutable OCR KEEP; score target-only mean PLL-word-l2r with frozen BERT MLM and fixed edit penalty/gain. Only OOV sources are considered; candidate set never consumes GT.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Separates candidate generation from contextual selection, but residual LM/length and language bias remain.

scientific_choices.rationale: Scene-only caption on the same 125 SHA-bound RGB images. Florence-2-large-ft replaces strict-paper BLIP-2 only in this approximate extension. Current prepared RGB manifest is lookup evidence; each image must equal the frozen source image hash.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Provides setting/object context; hallucinated scene text can damage correction.

scientific_choices.rationale: Existing main py311 with existing isolated pure-Python einops0.8.1, standalone CPU FP32 Florence, batch1, max64 output tokens, greedy beam1; separate caption/BERT processes and cached model stages. No environment creation or package installation.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Caption runtime differs from paper; generation/input/software/hash provenance and failures are saved.
